content_categories: Any other devotional or temple-related activities

Abhishekam.description: Sacred liquid bathing ritual over deity idol or Shiva Lingam

Aarti.description: Worship using lit lamps, camphor flame, bell ringing, and circular rotations

Pooja.description: General ritual worship offerings with flowers, deepa, and incense

Archana.description: Chanting of 108 or 1000 sacred names while offering flowers/kumkum

Bhajan.description: Devotional singing accompanied by harmonium, tabla, or cymbals

Kirtan / Nama Sankeerthana.description: Call-and-response devotional chanting of divine names

Pravachan / Spiritual Discourses.description: Scriptural lecture, commentary, and spiritual teachings

Homa / Yajna.description: Sacred fire altar rituals with oblation offerings

Temple Darshan.description: Visual view and darshan of sacred shrine idol

Festival Processions.description: Public chariot or palanquin street procession of deity

Annadanam.description: Offering and serving of free consecrated meals to devotees

Meditation / Chanting.description: Contemplative meditation and repetitive mantra japa
